news.title: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability

news.summary: ESMA will focus on CASP resilience, outsourcing and reverse solicitation while pursuing harmonized reporting across national regulators.

news.summary: Altseason is almost here and early signs suggest traders are becoming more selective, with capital flowing into revenue-generating protocols across a number of different narratives.

news.summary: AI agents could trigger a bank run by automatically moving household cash from low-interest checking accounts to higher-yield alternatives, Slok warns.

news.summary: Franklin Templeton’s tokenized money market shares can be used as collateral for USDT or USDC trading credit lines on Bybit while earning yield on the underlying assets.

news.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans public officials from launching memecoins, takes aim at Trump

news.title: Caution builds in the bitcoin market even as prices stay well above summer lows

news.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans

news.title: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'

news.title: Solana ETFs draw record $188 million in a week as Bitwise takes two-thirds of inflows

news.summary: Trump on Sunday didn’t rule out additional strikes on Iran before the midterm elections, even as he said the war could end soon.

news.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins

news.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit

news.title: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation

news.title: ‘It’s really not just a blockchain anymore’: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s path to 2030

news.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
news.summary: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.

news.title: Australia asks OpenAI, Anthropic chiefs to Senate inquiry on rogue hack: Report
news.summary: A rogue OpenAI research agent bypassed blocks on the Australian government health-data portal, accessing non-public files in June.

news.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart

news.title: Riot Platforms repays $200M credit facility, releases collateral
news.summary: The Bitcoin miner has continued to expand its data-center business as well.

news.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say

news.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2

news.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week

news.summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

news.title: SEC crypto FAQ addresses token buybacks, network upgrades and promises of profit

news.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails

news.title: Blockchain Association CEO Summer Mersinger to step down, Kristin Smith to return as interim CEO

news.title: Magic Eden legacy approvals leave $5.7 million in NFTs exposed to exploit before rescue
news.summary: Magic Eden legacy approvals exposed $5.7 million in NFTs to an exploit before whitehats rescued 23,155 tokens.

news.summary: The Federal Reserve proposed new measures for stablecoin issuers, including reserve-asset limits and standardized capital requirements.
